summary: Brief 4 H2a (foundation). New --m-* token values and tokens (greys, glass rgba(14,14,14,.62-.86) + blur(22px), orange accent #ff7a3d with ink #1a0a03, selection #9fd6ff, fire #ff6a2a/#ff8a3c, modeled #f5c060, stale #e8b04a, official #8fd3a8, alert #ee7aa0, top-bar geometry), the re-pointing block's gold alphas orange, blue/cyan literals removed from map-bridge.css and map-layout.css (plus a small sweep in location.css, map.css, overview.css, extras.css), the TypeScript colour mirrors updated (overlayModel TOKENS/OBSERVED_RGBA/FORECAST_RGBA, basemapStyle DARK to neutral greys, extras/style, official/style redFlag #ee7aa0), Inter 800 and theme-color #0c0c0c. Shared components: ui/Logo.tsx (re-exported from Header.tsx), ui/shell/TopBar.tsx family (TopBar, TopBarBrand, ViewPill, BackButton, LiveDot, IconPill, TopBarStatus, TopBarPlace) with styles/topbar.css, fixedCopy.ts + FixedCopy.tsx, Readout.tsx (ReadoutRow). App.tsx MapWorkspace now keeps one map mount, MapAtmosphere (stub), credits, loading line, status overlays, banners, toasts and tooltips and renders exactly one chrome (OverviewChrome, PublicFireChrome, CommandFireChrome: today's layouts moved verbatim, header converted to the floating TopBar); MapHeader.tsx replaced by the shared topBarItems.tsx + fireBarInfo.ts. State: overviewDetails/setOverviewDetails, device/setDevice, SelectionSource 'device', flyTo.bearingDeg + flyToLocal(x, z, distance?, bearingDeg?). Forensic-only CSS moved to forensic-entry.css. shot.mjs gained --shot-timeout and --quality low (Forensic fixture-live shot in 46 s under SwiftShader). Gates pass (lint 55 warnings, all src/scene).
files: tests: web/src/ui/shell/TopBar.test.ts, fixedCopy.test.ts, Readout.test.ts (new); views.test.ts, state/workspace.test.ts, state/store.test.ts (additions); map/basemapStyle.test.ts (dark background #0c0c0c and building colour #555555, deliberate)

verification.gates: typecheck ok; lint 55 warnings (baseline, all src/scene); vitest 79 files, 1230 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed; build ok
verification.map_never_remounts: Scratch Playwright check: the MapLibre canvas element is the same object across Public->Command (keyboard), Back to the overview, overview Public, and opening the fire again; data-view and .mw-atmo data-edges follow the chrome; focus lands on the new view pill after a switch and after Back
verification.behaviour_kept: Layers toggle aria-expanded + Escape closes; compact menu at 900 px (pill hidden, menu opens); phone Updates toggle labelled; useMapSafeArea publishes insets

contract_deviations: TopBar, IconPill and ViewPill take a few extra props beyond CONTRACT 15.2 (pass-through root/button attributes, ref, className); TopBarBrand and TopBarPlace are extra exports.

FixedCopy takes className and extra?: string | null (undefined = the variant default: line LIST_ABSENCE, corner/pill NOT_ALL_CLEAR, bar none; null = none). The H2a stubs use variant 'pill' with extra={null} inside the old .mw-note slot, so the note looks as before; H2b / H3+H4 pick their final variant.
The fixed-copy corner variant uses --m-text-4 (#8a8a8a) instead of the screen's #6f6f6f, which is under 4.5:1 on the ground (decision l).
MapHeader.tsx (listed for H3+H4 in PLAN-4 section 4) no longer exists; its items are in ui/shell/topBarItems.tsx and fireBarInfo.ts, which no step owns (shared).
The demo badge stays on the right of the bar in H2a (as today); PLAN-4 section 3.2 moves it after the place in H2b.
known_issues: Swapping chromes remounts their panels: the search box text, open menus, the coordinate strip's phone toggle and the credits toggle reset when the preset changes or a fire opens/closes (the map itself never remounts).
Until H2c fills MapAtmosphere, top-bar text sits directly on the map with only a text shadow: the overview title can be hard to read over bright aerial areas (e.g. snow in Canada on a phone).
Command's bar at 1280-1439 px hides the place (the incident ID chip takes the room); at 1440 the place is truncated. H2b moves the ID into the readout.
Forensic is unchanged except the new logo; header.css still gives the logo a gold drop-shadow (H5).
The overview markers (overviewLayers.ts PALETTE) are still today's colours (H3+H4).
Text contrast of the lighter glass over bright aerial was not measured in H2a (decision l, H2b/H3+H4).
notes_for_integrator: See notes_for_others in the H2a structured output: the seams for H2b (CommandFireChrome.tsx, topBarItems.tsx, Readout, FixedCopy corner) and H2c (MapAtmosphere.tsx + atmosphere.css, .mw[data-view], views.ts atmosphereEdgesOf, flyToLocal bearingDeg).
